evidence.reason: Line 177 substitutes the raw unit-name instance text for both `%i` and `%I`. systemd distinguishes them: `%i` is the escaped instance, while `%I` is the unescaped instance. For `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket`, `Service=%I.service` therefore resolves to `crq-tick.service`, but the code produces `crq\x2dtick.service`, so the target reference is missed. The smallest fix is to unescape the instance only for `%I` and leave `%i` unchanged.
